## Build an environment
1. Activate conda in your CRC account
1. Build an environment named 'test_python' which contains the following packages:
    - Python version 3.10
    - Black
    - Flake8
    - Numpy
    - Scipy
    - Pandas
1. Share a YAML export of the environment with your instructor.
